name: Mechanical — 2V — SolderWire
description: Mechanical cluster of 9 through-hole SolderWire footprint parts for 0.25 sq mm wire with 0.65 mm hole diameter and 2 mm outer diameter across 1x01, 1x05, and 1x06 pin configurations.
selection_hints: Select the required pin count configuration: 1x01, 1x05, or 1x06.
Choose the appropriate pad variant including standard, Relief, or Relief2x.
Ensure 4.5 mm pitch is suitable for 1x05 and 1x06 multi-pin footprints.
avoid_when: The design requires surface-mount mounting instead of through-hole.
Wire size or hole diameter differs from 0.25 sq mm and 0.65 mm.
Required pin count is not 1, 5, or 6 positions.
